base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_012 IS NULL OR c.XCL_012 = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.XCL_001)
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
INNER JOIN set_translations AS st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
WHERE c.XCL_004 = 'artifact'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'vintage'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  AND c.XCL_003 != 'split'
